summary: This diff fixes two trace-review filing bugs: (1) fan-out — one trace now produces one draft (with all findings grouped), not one per finding; (2) cross-board misrouting — the target board is resolved from the trace's session ID via the repos registry, falling back to the mill board when unrecognized, rather than guessing. Gap-id markers (`<!-- trace-review-gap-id: ... -->`) in ticket descriptions provide stable dedup across runs. The `trace_review_dedup_lookback_days` setting is retained as a no-op for backward-compatible config schemas (replaced by gap-id markers). `changelog.d/*.md` was added to the core module's path glob in `docs/modules.yaml`. No user-facing docs (README, config docs, agent docs) needed updating — the trace-review feature is internal infrastructure and all existing `trace_review_*` settings remain schema-compatible.
